## Core Competencies & Specializations
- **Web Automation**: Playwright with Python & Pytest, Page Object Model (POM) architecture, cross-browser test suites (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit), data-driven execution, resilient locator strategies, fixture management, and Playwright Trace Viewer debugging.
- **API Testing**: Postman collections, Newman CLI automation, REST & GraphQL verification, JSON schema validation, automated test assertions, mock servers, and environment parameterization.
- **Performance & Load Testing**: Apache JMeter load profiling, stress testing, response time analysis, throughput benchmarking, and bottleneck identification.
- **QA Lifecycle & Defect Management**: Manual test design (Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Decision Tables), Jira defect lifecycle, STLC workflows, smoke & regression test planning.
- **CI/CD Quality Gates**: GitHub Actions automated test runners, artifact archiving, HTML report generation, and continuous deployment validation.

## Live QA Projects & Interactive Test Reports
- [SauceDemo Playwright Automation Suite](https://tanzimsqa.github.io/saucedemo-playwright-automation/): Enterprise-grade E2E test automation framework built with Python, Pytest, and Playwright featuring full Page Object Model and detailed HTML execution reporting.
- [Playwright API Testing Framework](https://tanzimsqa.github.io/playwright-api-testing-framework/): Automated API test framework validating RESTful endpoints, payload integrity, schema contracts, and Newman integration.
- [Bangladesh Railway Web Application Manual Testing](https://github.com/TanzimSQA/Manual-Testing-For-BANGLADESH-Railway-Web-Application): Comprehensive manual testing documentation, test scenarios, RTM (Requirements Traceability Matrix), and defect reports for ticketing workflows.
- [GitHub Repositories](https://github.com/TanzimSQA): Comprehensive public test automation suites, utilities, and documentation.
